package handlers

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"io"
	"mime"
	"net/http"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/domain"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/usecase/diagnosticplan"
	"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5"
	"github.com/google/uuid"
)

type DiagnosticPlacementHandler struct {
	Placement diagnosticplan.PlacementConsumer
}

func (h DiagnosticPlacementHandler) Consume(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	w.Header().Set("Cache-Control", "no-store")
	studentID, planID, key := chi.URLParam(r, "studentID"), chi.URLParam(r, "planID"), r.Header.Get("Idempotency-Key")
	media, _, contentErr := mime.ParseMediaType(r.Header.Get("Content-Type"))
	if contentErr != nil || media != "application/json" || !canonicalHandlerUUID(studentID) || !canonicalHandlerUUID(planID) || key != planID {
		writeDiagnosticError(w, domain.ErrMalformed)
		return
	}
	var input domain.DiagnosticPlacementConsumeRequest
	decoder := json.NewDecoder(http.MaxBytesReader(w, r.Body, 64<<10))
	decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
	if err := decoder.Decode(&input); err != nil || decoder.Decode(&struct{}{}) != io.EOF {
		writeDiagnosticError(w, domain.ErrMalformed)
		return
	}
	decision, _, err := h.Placement.Consume(r.Context(), studentID, planID, key, input)
	if err != nil {
		writeDiagnosticError(w, err)
		return
	}
	writeDiagnosticJSON(w, http.StatusOK, decision)
}

func (h DiagnosticPlacementHandler) Get(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	w.Header().Set("Cache-Control", "no-store")
	studentID, planID := chi.URLParam(r, "studentID"), chi.URLParam(r, "planID")
	if !canonicalHandlerUUID(studentID) || !canonicalHandlerUUID(planID) {
		writeDiagnosticError(w, domain.ErrMalformed)
		return
	}
	decision, err := h.Placement.Get(r.Context(), studentID, planID)
	if err != nil {
		writeDiagnosticError(w, err)
		return
	}
	writeDiagnosticJSON(w, http.StatusOK, decision)
}

func canonicalHandlerUUID(raw string) bool {
	value, err := uuid.Parse(raw)
	return err == nil && value.String() == raw
}
